title: breaking-down-ba-scope stage input (POST-adapter payload at stage ba-breakdown)
description: The real payload the engine assembles for the S1b ba-breakdown stage: workflow input picks (raw_request, requester), the intake pick (normalized_request, scope), the nested advisory discovery handoff, and the engine-injected idempotency_key. ENFORCED fail-closed before the stage runs.

raw_request.description: The raw BA input (Jira, Slack, meeting notes, email, mixed prose or a structured requirement doc). Ground-truth stripped and PII-redacted at preflight.

requester.description: Named human who raised the request; provenance.

normalized_request.description: The PII-redacted normalized-request STRING produced by scoping-ba-intake (S0).

idempotency_key.description: Engine-injected; the whole workflow shares one key.

scope.description: The trimmed S0 scope contract. Advisory bounding context: it may narrow what is in play, never invent a rule or discharge a detector. Absent scope is byte-identical to scope-absent behaviour.

discovery.description: Optional engine-nested handoff from s1-discovery, delivered AFTER its human gate. ADVISORY ONLY: it may raise a tier floor, seed absent-stakeholder rows and seed pending regulatory-citation rows. It can NEVER suppress a detector, lower a tier, satisfy a citation, or replace raw_request. Absent discovery is byte-identical.

problem_framing.description: Accepts BOTH shapes: the structured triple emitted since researching-ba-problem-space 2.1.0, and the legacy narrative string that recorded artifacts carry. A discovery is advisory, so an older one must never fail this stage's input validation.

tier_signal.description: A tier FLOOR - may raise, never lower.

loop_back_feedback.description: Engine-injected on a loop_back. TWO shapes reach this stage and the schema documents both, because a contract that only describes the happy one fails the stage on its second attempt: (1) a THREE-AMIGOS loop_back carries source 'gate', the reviewers' verdict and their notes; (2) an EXECUTION-failure loop_back is re-derived from the stage artifact and carries verdict null with no reviewers.

verdict.description: The gate verdict that sent the work back; null on an execution-failure loop_back.

findings.description: Reviewer notes (strings, from the gate) or artifact findings (objects). Both are read as guidance, never as instructions.
